title: Explainable PQC: A Layered Interpretive Framework for Post-Quantum Cryptographic Security Assumptions
summary: This paper studies how post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) security assumptions can be represented and communicated through a structured, layered framework that is useful for technical interpretation but does not replace formal cryptographic proofs.
